A BIG YEAR FOR SWING DANCE KOBE

Kobe Jazz Street 2026

10 & 11 October 2026

Official festival websiteBuy tickets here

Help us fill the dance floor.

For the first time, Kobe Jazz Street Festival is giving us a dedicated venue for dancers. Let’s show that music and dance belong together! Bring your friends — dancers and non-dancers alike — and help make this an unforgettable year for Swing Dance Kobe.

Free mini dance lessons

Roger (Switzerland) & Lucy (Japan) will teach free mini lessons during every band break. A perfect chance for beginners to try swing dancing.
